ext:name: Workflows
ext:hint: Every page of the workflow console: a homepage's listing, a workflow, and a version, whose URL carries a repository path of unknown length, so that only a splat can match it - the page this mounts works out which of the three a URL addresses. A splat never names a crumb, so the console's root, which redirects to the listing of the homepage every deployment has, is routed without becoming a step in the trail; the pages add the steps above them themselves, each under its own title.
